authorInfo.bio: Mark Pattison (1813–1884) is the credited author of this historical edition. The source reference provides their catalogue and biographical references.

description: "Milton" by Mark Pattison is a biographical account written in the late 19th century that explores the life and works of the renowned poet John Milton. The book delves into Milton's background, tracing his familial roots, education, and the influence of various experiences on his literary output.
